title: CasePanel
description: A panel of synthetic (later: real) cases to run through compiled rules. Fields must match the union of the compilations' input schemas. Demographics ride along so harm and burden can be reported distributionally.

mode.description: fuzz = random from input schema (no API); llm_coverage = diverse realistic cases; llm_adversarial = generated to split two compilations; calibrated = matched to real marginals (ACS/assessor); real = actual records.

facts.description: field name -> value, matching the compilation input schema.

demographics.description: Optional; for distributional reporting only — must never appear in any predicate's inputs.

narrative.description: One-line human story for witness exhibits.
